design.text: Randomized (1:1:1), active-controlled, open-label, multicenter, two-part trial comparing encorafenib 450 mg daily plus binimetinib 45 mg twice daily vs encorafenib 300 mg monotherapy vs vemurafenib 960 mg twice daily.

citations.quote: BRAFTMTOVI in combination with binimetinib was evaluated in a randomized, active-controlled, open-label, multicenter trial (COLUMBUS; NCT01909453).

Patients were randomized (1:1:1) to receive BRAFTMTOVI 450 mg once daily in combination with binimetinib 45 mg twice daily (BRAFTMTOVI in combination with binimetinib), BRAFTMTOVI 300 mg once daily, or vemurafenib 960 mg twice daily.

population.text: Adults with BRAF V600E or V600K mutation-positive unresectable or metastatic melanoma, as detected using the bioMerieux THxID BRAF assay.

citations.quote: Eligible patients were required to have BRAF V600E or V600K mutation-positive unresectable or metastatic melanoma, as detected using the bioMerieux THxIDTMBRAF assay.

endpoint.text: Primary endpoint was progression-free survival (PFS) by RECIST v1.1 per blinded independent central review.

citations.quote: The primary endpoint of COLUMBUS was PFS, determined based on tumor assessment (RECIST version 1.1 criteria) as per blinded independent central review (BIRC).

n.text: 577 patients randomized; 192 to encorafenib+binimetinib, 194 to encorafenib, 191 to vemurafenib.

citations.quote: A total of 577 patients were randomized, 192 to the BRAFTMTOVI in combination with binimetinib arm, 194 to the BRAFTMTOVI arm, and 191 to the vemurafenib arm.

result.text: Median PFS 14.9 months (encorafenib+binimetinib) vs 7.3 months (vemurafenib); HR 0.54 (95% CI 0.41, 0.71), p<0.0001. ORR 63% vs 40%.

indication.text: BRAFTOVI is indicated, in combination with binimetinib, for the treatment of patients with unresectable or metastatic melanoma with a BRAF V600E or V600K mutation, as detected by an FDA-approved test. Not indicated for wild-type BRAF melanoma.

citations.quote: BRAFTOVI™ is indicated, in combination with binimetinib, for the treatment of patients with unresectable or metastatic melanoma with a BRAF V600E or V600K mutation, as detected by an FDA-approved test [see *Dosage and Administration* (2.1)].
Limitations of Use: BRAFTOVI is not indicated for treatment of patients with wild-type BRAF melanoma [see *Warnings and Precautions* (5.2)].

target_moa.text: Encorafenib is a kinase inhibitor that targets kinases in the RAS/RAF/MEK/ERK pathway, inhibiting BRAF V600E, wild-type BRAF, and CRAF with IC50 of 0.35, 0.47 and 0.30 nM, respectively.

key_safety.text: Most common adverse reactions (>=25%) with BRAFTOVI in combination with binimetinib are fatigue, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, and arthralgia. Important toxicities include new primary malignancies, tumor promotion in BRAF wild-type tumors, hemorrhage, uveitis, and QT prolongation.
